svg.title: An internal response precedes a closed layer
svg.desc: Put the obtained response before a still-closed administrator boundary. Preserve two privilege levels: receiving an internal response has not yet established administrative control. Visual distinction: Nested privilege layers and a keyhole distinguish authority from network reach. The inner authority layer remains closed.
